issues.desc: index.json description carries over the parenthetical citation "dev-memory 148297b" (used to support the claim that worktree-built CLI is "the documented story-development practice") with no inline explanation of what that reference is or where a fresh reader could look it up. Grep confirms 148297b is a real memory-entry id used elsewhere in the repo (e.g. .lattice/story/actives/B-cc94/evidence/transcript-diff.md), so the underlying claim is not fabricated, but per Dimension 2 standalone-readability guidance, cross-references without a one-sentence explanation on first appearance should be avoided in story metadata a fresh reader consumes independently.
